name: Lunge Matrix
description: A multi-directional warm-up sequence combining anterior, lateral, and drop-step lunges.
instructionsEn:
Stand tall and step forward into an anterior lunge, then push back to center.
Step the same leg to the side, bend that hip and knee, and return to center.
Step the same leg back and away at a 45-degree angle for a drop-step lunge, then return.
Complete the sequence on the other side.

name: Diagonal Lunge
description: A dynamic warm-up lunge performed by stepping outward at a 45-degree angle.
instructionsEn:
Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg out at a 45-degree angle while keeping the shoulders square.
Drop the hips toward the floor with the front foot flat and chest up.
Push off the front leg to return to standing, then repeat on the other side.

name: Weighted Lunge
description: A forward lunge performed while wearing a securely fastened weighted vest.
instructionsEn:
Fasten the weighted vest securely and stand with the feet shoulder-width apart.
Step one foot forward and lower into a lunge while keeping the back straight.
Keep the front knee aligned with the direction of the foot.
Push through the front leg to return to standing, then repeat with the other leg.

name: Sandbag Lunge
description: A loaded lunge performed with a sandbag secured across the upper back or shoulders.
instructionsEn:
Place the sandbag securely across your shoulders and stand with the feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot forward and lower with an upright torso until the back knee approaches the floor.
Keep the front knee aligned with the foot.
Push through the front heel to return to standing, then repeat with the other leg.
